🦍 DonkeyKong

Classic platformer: Donkey Kong hurls barrels down the structure, and you must climb ladders to reach the top and rescue the princess. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Use left/right arrows to walk along platforms.
  2. Press Up to climb ladders when standing at one.
  3. Jump over rolling barrels — timing is everything.
  4. Some barrels roll faster or follow different paths.
  5. Reach the top platform to advance to the next level.
